title: Easy Chicken and Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: This quick chicken stir-fry goes great with white rice, jasmine rice, or fried rice, plus icy orange soda and, of course, La Choy® crispy fried noodles!
ingredients: 1.5 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
2 (8 ounce) cans sliced water chestnuts, drained
0.5 pound fresh green beans, cut into pieces
0.5 pound fresh broccoli, cut into pieces
0.5 pound fresh green cabbage, cut into pieces
7 green onion stalks, cut into pieces
2 tablespoons sesame seeds, or to taste
2 tablespoons ground ginger, or to taste

steps.text: Heat oil in a large wok over high heat. Add chicken, water chestnuts, celery, carrots, green beans, mushrooms, bean sprouts, broccoli, cabbage, stir-fry sauce, garlic, green onion, sesame seeds, ground ginger, and salt. Cook, stirring often, until vegetables are tender to taste and chicken is no longer pink inside and juices run clear, 20 to 30 minutes.
